config.name: qwen
config.prompt: Detect every visible adult butterfly or moth. Give each individual one tight bounding box covering only its visible parts. Ignore other insects, caterpillars, pupae, and shadows. Return only a JSON array of objects with "bbox_2d": [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], using integer coordinates from 0 to 1000 relative to the full image. Return [] if no adult butterfly or moth is visible.
